MailSecurity.description: How the connection to the mail server is encrypted. There is no unencrypted mail.

oneOf.description: TLS from the first byte, usually on port 465.
A plain connection upgraded with STARTTLS, usually on port 587; fails if the server can't upgrade.

MailServer.description: Mail sent through an SMTP server.

user.description: The name to sign in with; empty for a server that takes mail without signing in.

NotifyWhen.description: Which runs a channel is told about.

oneOf.description: Every run that failed, and the first pass after a failure.
The first failure of a test that passed before, and the first pass after a failure; a test that keeps failing says nothing more.

SlackChannel.description: The Slack channel of the webhook.

TelegramChat.description: A Telegram chat a bot posts to.

chat.description: The chat's id, like `-1001234567890` for a group, or `@channel` for a public channel.

description: How a project tells people how its test runs went, in `jevision.notifications.json` in the project folder: a message to Slack, Telegram or email, each with when to send it. Webhooks, tokens and passwords are secret and never go in this file.

email.description: Mail sent through an SMTP server. The password is secret and never goes in this file.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

slack.description: Messages to the Slack channel of an incoming webhook. The webhook is secret and never goes in this file.

telegram.description: Messages a Telegram bot posts to a chat. The bot's token is secret and never goes in this file.

unattendedOnly.description: Only runs started by a schedule or on CI are told about, not the ones someone watched.

title: JEVision notifications
